**Published:** [DATE]

## Company Overview

**La Filipina Uy Gongco Group of Companies (LFUGGOC)** is a major Philippine conglomerate operating across multiple industries including food manufacturing, flour milling, animal feed production, sugar processing, livestock farming, port operations, logistics, and real estate.

**Website:** foodgroup.ph
**Headquarters:** Taguig City (BGC), Metro Manila, Philippines
**Employees:** 1,500+
**Annual Revenue:** Estimated PHP 15-20 billion ($270-360M USD)
**Auditor:** SGV & Co. (Ernst & Young Philippines)
**ERP:** SAP S/4HANA

The group operates 17+ legal entities across the Philippines with nationwide operations spanning Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao regions, including 6+ port terminals, flour mills, feed mills, sugar centrals, farms, retail stores, and distribution networks.

- **Annual Financial Statements** (AFS) for all business units
- **Budget files** for 2022-2027 including forward projections

- **Loan documents** including PHP 300M+ BPI promissory notes and amortization schedules

## Regulatory Implications

This data is subject to the **Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173)**, which requires:
- **Mandatory breach notification** to the National Privacy Commission (NPC) within 72 hours
- **Notification to affected data subjects** (1,500+ employees and thousands of customers)
- Penalties of up to **PHP 5,000,000** and **imprisonment of 3-6 years** for violations

The company has **5 business days** to respond before data publication begins.
